entries.text: 短脛狗。从犬卑聲。
兒# infant(ile) + 犬 dog/beast → small variety of *lion*. In Buddhism the character signifies a seat of a buddha, and by extension that of a high priest.
犾# as described in 獄 (dogs tangling in a fight) + 犬 dog/beast → circling pack of dogs. "Whirlwind" and "storm" are via the compound 猋風, which in turn generated the single character 飆.
犬走皃。从三犬。
犬張齗怒也。从犬來聲。讀又若銀。
飽也。从甘从肰。
昌# prosperous + 犬 dog/beast. The meanings *violent*, *go on a rampage*, *unruly* and *frenzied* are via extension (violently active ← vigorous ← prosperous) → *rampant*.
犗犬也。从犬奇聲。
鳥也。从隹犬聲。睢陽有猚水。
As per 孟# (energetic → frenetic) + 犬 dog/beast → frenetic activity of a dog/beast (compare 狂 and 戻) → *fierce*; *strong*; *fly into a rage*.
健犬也。从犬孟聲。

青# blue/green (→ bluish black; compare 鯖) + 犬 dog/beast → black dog, faintly visible → *doubt* (← faint veracity ← faintly visible) → *suspect* (v.) (← doubt a person's veracity). Also, *envy* and *jealousy* (← dark products of a suspicious mind).
恨賊也。从犬青聲。
As per 卒# (compact) + 犬 dog/beast → *sudden*; *abrupt* (← sudden attack made by wild animals closing in on prey).
犬从艸暴出逐人也。从犬卒聲。
As per 畏# (lumpy being) + 犬 dog/beast → gruesome, beastly figure → *obscene*; *vulgar* (← gruesome).
犬吠聲。从犬畏聲。
As per 星# (bright) + 犬 dog/beast → imaginary animal with a bald, shiny pate and human-like face, for which (a particular species of) *orangutan* may or may not have been the original inspiration.
猩猩，犬吠聲。从犬星聲。
As per 者# (pile) + 犬 dog/beast → wild *boar* with voluminous piles of fat. A variant form, 豬, which replaces 犬 with 豕 pig/boar, appears in the derivative character 瀦.
犬 dog/beast + 苗# for the sound alone to simulate the mewing of a *cat*.
猰㺄，獸名。从犬契聲。
柔# soft + 犬 dog/beast → soft-haired *monkey*.
短喙犬也。从犬曷聲。《詩》曰：“載獫猲獢。”《爾雅》曰：“短喙犬謂之猲獢。”
As per 侯# (lumpy object) + 犬 dog/beast → lump-shaped ape/*monkey*.
夒也。从犬矦聲。
獺屬。从犬扁聲。

As per 酋# (rise; elongated) + 犬 dog/beast → animal arching its back in fear/aggression → *prolong* (← extend in time ← extend in size) → *delay*; *hesitation* → *still*; *yet* (← go beyond normal bounds).
玃屬。从犬酋聲。一曰隴西謂犬子爲猷。
Effectively a variant form of 獸 (drive a beast/wild animal into a snare or enclosure) with the meanings *plan*, *scheme* or *measure* (← consider how to drive prey into a trap).

As per 骨# (circulate) + 犬 dog/beast → pack animals that hunt by tightening a circle about their prey (compare 獪) → *sly*; *cunning* (compare 狡) → *(put into) disorder* (← use cunning to upset the customary order).
犬 dog/beast + 袁#. The original form of the character, however, was 犬 + 爰 (twist about) → the twisting figure of an ape or *monkey*.
南趙名犬獿獀。从犬叜聲。
犾# is a depiction of two dogs, suggesting a pair of dogs tangling in a fight. 獄 adds 言 words → *trial*; *suit*; *sue* (← be entangled in a harsh dispute; compare 訟) → *prison*.
确也。从㹜从言。二犬，所以守也。
犬 dog/beast + 師# for the sound alone to transliterate the first syllable of the Sanskrit simha (lion).
狼屬。从犬曼聲。《爾雅》曰：“貙獌，似貍。”
As per 將# (prod forward) + 大 stand outstretched → extend the arms in prodding others forward → *encourage*; *promote*.

As per 莫# (concealed) + 犬 dog/beast → (dimly visible and) imaginary beast believed to eat copper, iron and nightmares. *Tapir* is a borrowed meaning. A variant form, 貘, replaces 犬 with 豸 animal that ambles along the ground.
犬如人心可使者。从犬敖聲。《春秋傳》曰：“公嗾夫獒。”
As per 厥# (seizure) + 犬 dog/beast → *unruly* beast → *storm about* → *fly into a rage*.
頓仆也。从犬敝聲。《春秋傳》曰：“與犬，犬獘。”
健也。从犬粦聲。《詩》曰：“盧獜獜。”
𤜵犬也。从犬堯聲。
As per 尞# as described in 僚 (ring of flames) + 犬 dog/beast → *hunt at night* with torches, closing a circle around prey (compare 獪 and 猾).
獵也。从犬尞聲。
犬獡獡不附人也。从犬舄聲。南楚謂相驚曰獡。讀若愬。
猲獢也。从犬喬聲。
As per 睘# as described in 環 (circular) + 犬 dog/beast → chained/penned *dog running about in circles* → *oversensitive* (compare the sense of irritability in 悁 and of excessive seriousness in 愿).
疾跳也。一曰急也。从犬瞏聲。
As per 蜀# (adhere) + 犬 dog/beast → adhere to one spot (compare 主 and 豆) in the manner of a *solitary* watchdog → *(a)lone*. *Germany* is via the phonetic construction 獨逸 (独逸).
犬相得而鬬也。从犬蜀聲。羊爲羣，犬爲獨也。一曰北嚻山有獨𤞞獸，如虎，白身，豕鬣，尾如馬。
As per 會# (reduce/eliminate space) + 犬 dog/beast → pack animals that cleverly hem in prey → *sly*; *cunning*. Compare 猾.
狡獪也。从犬會聲。
長喙犬。一曰黑犬黃頭。从犬僉聲。
As per 寧# (settle) + 犬 dog/beast → tenacious, unyielding beast → *ferocious*; *terrifying*.
As per 賓# (contact) + 犬 dog/beast → animal that adheres close to water while on land. The compound 獱獺 refers to a variety of otter.
A variant form# of 矍 (enclose in the hands) + 犬 dog/beast → enclose caught prey (in the hands) → *gain*; *obtain*.
獵所獲也。从犬蒦聲。

entries.text: 怒犬皃。从犬需聲。讀若槈。

巤 is a depiction of a pheasant with bound wings, captured by being pressured from all sides in hunting. 獵 is 巤# + 犬 dog/beast → *hunting* (in general). *Fishing* and *shellfish gathering* are associated meanings.
放獵逐禽也。从犬巤聲。
廣 here an abbreviated form# of 壙 open wilderness + 犬 dog/beast → *wild, undomesticated dog* → *uncivilized*; *coarse*.
犬獷獷不可附也。从犬廣聲。漁陽有獷平縣。

嘼# combines an abbreviated form of 單 (weapon) and 囗 circular enclosure → use weapons to surround and drive a *beast/wild animal* into a snare or enclosure (compare 狩 and 逐) → *brute*. 獸 adds 犬 dog/beast for emphasis/clarification.
守備者。从嘼从犬。
賴 here an abbreviated form# of 瀨/瀬 shallows + 犬 dog/beast → *otter* (← animal that inhabits shallows).
如小狗也。水居食魚。从犬賴聲。

鬳 is composed of 虍 tiger + 鬲 tripod cooking vessel/cauldron → tripod cooking vessel with tiger and other decorations. 獻 is 鬳# + 犬 dog/beast → *offer* a sacrificial vessel filled high with meat of a dog/wild beast → *present*.
宗廟犬名羹獻。犬肥者以獻之。从犬鬳聲。
獿㺒也。从犬、夒。

As per 矍# (enclose in the hands) + 犬 dog/beast → large, predatory *ape* (← take prey captive in the hands). Compare the phonetically close 禺 and 猴 as well as the more common character 猿, all of which refer to simians.
母猴也。从犬矍聲。《爾雅》云：“玃父善顧。”攫持人也。

The relevant bronzeware inscription form shows *slender* threads twisted together and thus linked → *darkness* (← so slender as to be barely perceptible, a situation likened to darkness) → *obscure*; *mysteriousness*; *black*.
幽遠也。黑而有赤色者爲玄。象幽而入覆之也。凡玄之屬皆从玄。
急戾也。从弦省，少聲。
黑也。从二玄。《春秋傳》曰：“何故使吾水兹？”

The present form is 十 (gather) + an element# combining a slender thread and protruding objects → curved threads brought into alignment, creating a compact unit → *proportion*; *ratio* (the リツ term). The meanings *command* and *lead* are from the once-separate ソツ term, which suggested the idea of gathering in a neat line and tightening into an orderly unit.
捕鳥畢也。象絲罔，上下其竿柄也。凡率之屬皆从率。
黑色也。从玄，旅省聲。義當用黸。
A depiction of a circular, jeweled object → *precious stone*; *jewel*; *gem* → *round object* such as a *ball* or *lens* (compare 球).
石之美。有五德：潤澤以溫，仁之方也；䚡理自外，可以知中，義之方也；其聲舒揚，尃以遠聞，智之方也；不橈而折，勇之方也；銳廉而不技，絜之方也。象三玉之連。|，其貫也。凡玉之屬皆从玉。[陽冰曰：“三畫正均如貫玉也。”]

The relevant oracle bone form of this character is a person extending from earth (bottom line) to the arched heavens (top line) → *king* (← ruler whose dominion extends from earth to heaven, bringing them into harmony; compare 君 and 帝).
天下所歸往也。董仲舒曰：“古之造文者，三畫而連其中謂之王。三者，天、地、人也，而參通之者王也。”孔子曰：“一貫三爲王。”凡王之屬皆从王。[李陽冰曰：“中畫近上。王者，則天之義。”]
玉聲也。从玉丁聲。齊太公子伋謚曰玎公。
玉也。从玉工聲。
玓瓅，明珠色。从玉勺聲。
干# thick bar + 玉 jewel → stick-shaped *accessory* attached to clothing.
琅玕也。从玉干聲。《禹貢》：“雝州球琳琅玕。”
久 here an abbreviated form# of 灸 moxibustion + 玉 jewel → beautiful jewel the color of charred moxa → *beautiful black gem*. *Nine* is a borrowed meaning.
石之次玉黑色者。从玉久聲。《詩》曰：“貽我佩玖。”讀若芑。或曰若人句脊之句。
石之似玉者。从玉于聲。
玉也。从玉己聲。
火齊，玫瑰也。一曰石之美者。从玉文聲。
大圭也。从玉介聲。《周書》曰：“稱奉介圭。”
石之次玉者。以爲系璧。从玉丰聲。讀若《詩》曰“瓜瓞菶菶”。一曰若𧊧蚌。
As per 夬# (scoop out) + 玉 jewel → *jewel* in the shape of a reverse C, which was attached to a waistband. *Leather archery glove* is a borrowed meaning (compare 抉).
玉佩也。从玉夬聲。
二玉相合爲一𤤴。凡𤤴之屬皆从𤤴。
As per 元# (round) + 玉 jewel → toy/*play with* a round gem (compare 弄) → *enjoy*; *take pleasure in* (compare 翫). Also, *trifle with* and *make sport of*.
弄也。从玉元聲。
玪𤨙，石之次玉者。从玉今聲。
As per 攵# (strike) + 玉 jewel → strike a gem in processing it. 玫瑰 refers to either a red gem or a red-flowered sweetbrier (Rosa rubiginosa).
珠也。从玉比聲。宋弘云：“淮水中出玭珠。”玭，珠之有聲。
As per 令# (long sequence) + 玉 jewel → prolonged *tinkling of a string of jewels* (compare 琳 and 瓏).
玉聲。从玉令聲。
As per 占# (fixed in place) + 玉 jewel → *flaw in a jewel* (← permanent blemish) → (human) *flaw*.
玉 jewel + 皮# for the sound alone to transliterate the first syllable of the Pali phatika (crystal: 玻璃). Also, *glass*.
玉色鮮也。从玉此聲。《詩》曰：“新臺有玼。”
石之次玉者。从玉句聲。讀若苟。
白# white + 玉 jewel → whitish yellow jewel. The compound 琥珀 refers to *amber*.
As per 可# (bend) + 玉 jewel → jewel cut into a bent shape → *white agate*.
玉也。从玉可聲。
琮玉之瑑。从玉且聲。
As per 加# (place atop) + 玉 jewel → (woman's) *hair ornament*, placed atop the head/hair. The compound 珈琲, meaning coffee, is a transliteration of the Dutch Koffie.
婦人首飾。从玉加聲。《詩》曰：“副筓六珈。”
As per 民# (blind) + 玉 jewel → a *stone* of a blinding/dazzling (red) hue.
石之美者。从玉民聲。
As per 冊# (bamboo slats) + 玉 jewel → (slat-like) *coral*. *Centimeter* is a borrowed meaning.
珊瑚，色赤，生於海，或生於山。从玉，刪省聲。
佩刀下飾。天子以玉。从玉必聲。
The right-hand element# is 彡 pattern + 𠆢 a variant of 人 person → hair fully layered over a person's head. 珍 adds 玉 jewel → fully perfect (= flawless) jewel → *unusual*; *rare*.
寶也。从玉㐱聲。
蜃屬。从玉劦聲。《禮》：“佩刀，士珕琫而珧珌。”
玉也。从玉共聲。
朽玉也。从玉有聲。讀若畜牧之畜。
玉也。从玉羽聲。
As per 朱# (stump) + 玉 jewel → *pearl* (← stump-like jewel produced by a mollusk).
蚌之陰精。从玉朱聲。《春秋國語》曰：“珠以禦火灾”是也。
禁也。神農所作。洞越。練朱五弦，周加二弦。象形。凡珡之屬皆从珡。
石之似玉者。从玉艮聲。
醫無閭珣玗琪，《周書》所謂夷玉也。从玉旬聲。一曰器，讀若宣。
耳# ear + 玉 jewel → *jeweled ear ornament*.
瑱也。从玉、耳，耳亦聲。
玉也。从玉向聲。
蜃甲也。所以飾物也。从玉兆聲。《禮》云：“佩刀，天子玉琫而珧珌。”
行# (straight and crossing) + 玉 jewel → a horizontally aligned *jewel* at the top of a vertical string of jewels hung from the waist.
佩上玉也。所以節行止也。从玉行聲。
As per 圭# (cone-shaped) + 玉 jewel → jeweled *tablet/scepter*, the crown of which formed a cone shape. *Silicon* is a meaning expressed by the compound 珪素.

玨 (玉 jewel in abbreviated form, and doubled) + what was originally 八# split right and left → split a round gem in two → *group*; *squadron* (← large group of people split into smaller units, which however remain coordinated).
分瑞玉。从𤤴从刀。

As per the right-hand element# described in 佩 (cloth worn about the waist as a belt or accessory) + 玉 jewel → *jewel/jeweled ornament* (particularly, one attached to a cloth or belt worn about the waist).
大圭。長三尺，抒上，終葵首。从玉廷聲。

見# appear + 玉 jewel → gem appearing from the earth in being excavated → *appear*; *emerge* → *actual*; *real*; *existing* (← actuality/reality of that which has appeared/emerged) → *current*; *the present*. Also, *show* (← cause to appear).
